reserveReview.rationale: Current-source re-measurement at Sonic block 77819356 (2026-08-20T14:21:05Z), replacing the 2026-07-30 envelope. The facilitator bucket reports currentBorrowed = 1,313,027.46 bnUSD (cap 2,500,000); the SODAX API enumerates 50 current borrowers and 24 nonzero reserve positions. Summing every borrower aToken balance and pricing each reserve with the pool Aave oracle getAssetPrice at the current Sonic read gives total backing $3,613,750.65 and collateralizationRatio 2.752228. Composition: sodahyTB $1,162,497 (32.16872978%), sodaUSDC $717,244 (19.84762818%), sodaUSDT $471,154 (13.03781973%), sodaBTC $352,884 (9.76503988%), sodaBNB $218,339 (6.04190304%), sodaAVAX $114,838 (3.17779144%), sodaSUI $107,827 (2.98382253%), sodasftUSD $99,893 (2.76423407%), sodaETH $88,541 (2.45011420%), sodaSODA $88,030 (2.43599211%), sodaWEETH $61,649 (1.70595983%), sodaHYPE $44,185 (1.22269177%), sodaSOL $28,540 (0.78975098%), sodaWSTETH $27,800 (0.76929741%), and a fully enumerated 0.83922505% tail (sodaNEAR, sodaPOL, sodaXLM, bnUSD, sodaS, sodaINJ, sodaWBTC, sodaKAIA, sodaLL, sodaSUSDS dust). The latest position set still includes the full borrower-collateral base; the Stability Fund's approved-stablecoin swaps mint through the same facilitator and are therefore not an additive unmeasured layer. At Sonic block 78468970, sodasftUSD 0x0902...8685 reported supported token 0xd1e5...aeb1, identified on-chain as sftUSD; sftUSD asset() returned 0xf7d85ec4e7710f71992752eac2111312e73e9c9c, the exact tracked Sonic ftUSD contract, and convertToAssets(1e6) returned 1e6. The 2.76423407% sodasftUSD slice is therefore linked through the wrappers to ftusd-flying-tulip. hyTB remains identified as HiYield Treasury Bill Vault (SnowTrace token 0x8475509d391e6ee5A8b7133221CE17019D307B3E); the SODAX audits index still lists no report scoped to the hub EVM money-market Pool.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: 100% of measured bnUSD backing sits as borrower aToken collateral inside the SODAX money-market Pool on the Sonic hub: pooled (omnibus) smart-contract custody with no legal segregation or bankruptcy estate, and Aave-style pool design permits supplied assets to be lent out. Upstream custody layers (the HiYield T-bill vault's off-chain custodian, Circle/Tether issuance, and SODAX spoke-chain asset managers holding underlying tokens) remain as dependency risk carried on the individual reserve slices rather than as unidentified custody.
